title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Customer Success Specialist. You will own the long-term success, retention, and expansion of active customers. This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Conduct regular account performance and campaign reviews
  • Analyze metrics (deliverability, response rates, conversion signals, etc)
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Advise customers on campaign optimization, list strategy, volume, and cadence
  • Act as a trusted partner focused on ROI and lead outcomes
  • Identify expansion opportunities aligned with customer growth (users, volume, add-ons)
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or churn risk - escalate and resolve
  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: SAP BTP CAP/RAP
description:
Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) SAP com sólida experiência em extensões na SAP BTP, utilizando CAP e RAP, para atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções cloud nativas integradas a ambientes SAP (ECC/S/4HANA).

Vaga hibrida qualquer cidade.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicações e extensões na SAP BTP utilizando CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Implementar APIs, serviços OData/REST, lógica de negócio e integrações com sistemas SAP on-premise e cloud.
  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de aplicações existentes, realizando correções, melhorias e otimizações de performance.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo na área de TI (Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou cursos correlatos).
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento SAP.
  • Experiência sólida com SAP BTP e desenvolvimento utilizando CAP (Node.js/Java) e RAP (ABAP RESTful).
  • Bom domínio de ABAP OO, modelos de dados SAP, CDS Views, OData e conceitos de clean core.
  • Vivência com Git e práticas de desenvolvimento moderno (code review, testes, pipelines básicos).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma, com boa comunicação em times distribuídos.

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Certificações SAP em BTP, CAP, RAP ou S/4HANA.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Developer (Pl)
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!

Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Desenvolvedora (Pl) para se unir ao nosso Time de Dev-Admin Tools para:

  • Desenvolvimento de novas features e correções de bugs, seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Participação do ciclo de vida completo do desenvolvimento de projetos de Software;
  • Auxílio ativo no refinamento de necessidades técnicas;
  • Participação dos ritos em um modelo de desenvolvimento ágil;
  • Execução de testes de desenvolvimento e auxílio ao time de QA para validação das entregas;
  • Apoio os times de Operações, Projetos e Produtos nas necessidades técnicas;
  • Apoio ao cliente em dúvidas relacionadas com a integração com os nossos produtos.


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Experiência com planejamento, e estimava de desenvolvimento de Software;
  • Experiência com Java 11 e 17+, SpringBoot, APIs REST, Arquitetura de microsserviços, CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento em Docker e Orchestrador;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura baseada a eventos e serviços de mensageria;
  • Conhecimento em HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, React (hooks, componentização e ciclo de vida);
  • Conhecimentos de segurança no back-end (validação de entrada, controle de acesso, OWASP Top 10).
  • Conhecimento de segurança no front-end (XSS, CSRF, CORS, armazenamento seguro de tokens);
  • Conhecimento de Spring MVC, Spring Validation e Spring Data JPA;
  • Conhecimento de responsividade;
  • Proficiência na qualidade das entregas e do funcionamento das soluções desenvolvidas como um todo;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de versionamento de código e práticas CI/CD (Git);
  • Conhecimento sobre processo de desenvolvimento de software/engenharia de software, da concepção à entrega;
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e escrita de queries eficientes;
  • Conhecimento dos principais Design Patterns;
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de desenvolvimento: SOLID, K.I.S.S, Clean Code;
  • Conhecimento de base de dados (SQL, noSql);
  • Conhecimento de testes unitários.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Experiência com testes unitários no front-end;
  • Conhecimentos em Linux para desenvolvimento e operação de aplicações;
  • Uso de mensageria (RabbitMQ);
  • Noções de Docker;
  • Conhecimento em análise e aperfeiçoamento de performance de APIs;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • WellHub (antiga Gympass);
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida.


Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

title: Platform Engineer / DevOps Engineer SR
description:
Descrição da Vaga

Buscamos um(a) Platform Engineer / DevOps Engineer SR para atuar na construção e evolução de serviços de infraestrutura de plataforma, adotando práticas modernas de automação, observabilidade e infraestrutura como produto, suportando times de desenvolvimento com ambientes escaláveis, seguros e resilientes.


Atuação para um cliente sediado em Portugal


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter serviços de infraestrutura de plataforma baseados em containers e Kubernetes;
  • Projetar e implementar serviços de infraestrutura como produtos reutilizáveis;
  • Automatizar o ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento e operação da infraestrutura;
  • Implementar e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD e práticas GitOps;
  • Trabalhar com provedores de nuvem, especialmente Azure ou GCP;
  • Implementar e manter soluções de monitoramento e observabilidade (Grafana, Prometheus);
  • Aplicar práticas de Infrastructure as Code (IaC) utilizando Terraform, Crossplane ou ferramentas similares;
  • Atuar em ambientes Linux, redes, TCP/IP e serviços de segurança;
  • Colaborar de forma próxima com times de produto e desenvolvimento.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação remota no fuso horário de Portugal


Requisitos

  • Experiência prática com Kubernetes (certificação CKA ou OpenShift obrigatória);
  • Experiência com CI/CD e GitOps (GitHub Actions, Argo CD ou similares);
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em Azure ou GCP;
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade (Grafana, Prometheus);
  • Experiência com IaC (Terraform, Crossplane);
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Linux, redes e segurança;
  • Perfil colaborativo, com mentalidade de produto e foco em automação.


Diferenciais

  • Certificações adicionais em Kubernetes, Cloud ou DevOps;
  • Experiência com SRE, reliability engineering ou plataformas internas;
  • Vivência em ambientes complexos e distribuídos.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Customer Success Specialist. You will own the long-term success, retention, and expansion of active customers. This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Conduct regular account performance and campaign reviews
  • Analyze metrics (deliverability, response rates, conversion signals, etc)
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Advise customers on campaign optimization, list strategy, volume, and cadence
  • Act as a trusted partner focused on ROI and lead outcomes
  • Identify expansion opportunities aligned with customer growth (users, volume, add-ons)
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or churn risk - escalate and resolve
  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: Senior DataOps Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

The client operates in the health and information services domain, with a strong focus on enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale. Their mission centers on building a modern, cloud-based data platform that serves as a single source of truth for business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. The culture emphasizes data quality, governance, scalability, and collaboration across engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.


About the role

This role is focused on building and operating a robust data platform on Azure using Databricks. The engineer will play a key part in DataOps, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and reliability across enterprise-scale pipelines. You will design monitoring frameworks, implement data quality checks, and support governance initiatives. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders. It also requires strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a robust monitoring stack for jobs executed in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric, and other platform tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data catalogs in Unity Catalog and Purview
  • Design and implement a scalable framework for data quality checks across hundreds of columns on large datasets
  • Monitor data completeness and accuracy to ensure published data meets acceptable criteria
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions
  • Troubleshoot and optimize big data workflows for performance and scalability
  • Support governance and oversight of data pipelines and transformation activities
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in big data and analytics


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering / DataOps
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a Databricks environment (any cloud)
  • Strong experience with DataOps practices
  • Strong experience with data catalogs
  • Strong experience implementing data quality checks at scale
  • Strong Python experience
  • Strong proficiency in Data Governance processes and tools
  • Experience with Purview and/or Unity Catalog
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing
  • Experience with ETL processes, data cleaning, and large-scale data transformation
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an analytics-driven mindset
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience


Nice to have skills

  • Experience with Azure cloud services (preferred)
  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with GCP
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with DevOps practices


Conditions

  • 100% Remote role , primarily aligned to UTC-5 (EST) with a minimum of 5 hours overlap required
  • Contractor role – 6-month contract, renewable based on budget and performance
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week)
  • BYOD requirement

title: UI/UX Graphic Designer | Remote | Brazil | Full-Time
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right. We’re seeking experienced, creative graphic designers to join our growing team.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.



What We’re Looking For


We’re looking for team players who live and breathe design. People who are creative powerhouses and thrive on pushing boundaries and finding ways to bring fresh ideas to life. Ready to join our team and start designing?


About You


  • You’re super motivated and genuinely passionate about nailing the job every time.
  • You’re a problem-solver, always a few steps ahead and never caught off guard.
  • You bring good vibes to the table—you’re respectful, friendly, and a great collaborator.
  • You’re a time management wizard.
  • You’re a team player
  • Communication is your jam—clear, concise, and always spot-on.
  • You’re resourceful—if you don’t know something, you don’t flinch. You’ve got Google, you’ve got grit, and you always figure it out.
  • Bonus points if you geek out on things like DND, Pokémon, or video games. Our team’s got some serious nerd cred, and we’re looking for like-minded peeps to join!


Qualifications and Skills


  • 2+ years of hands-on design experience—show us your growth and expertise
  • Proficiency in Figma and Webflow. You know the ins and outs of these tools like your favourite video game’s cheat codes
  • Mastery of the Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign—you live and breathe these tools.
  • A killer design portfolio that shows off your best work.
  • Working level of English (enough to communicate your ideas clearly, both in writing and speaking).
  • A bachelor’s degree is a plus.
  • Comfortable with Microsoft Office & Google Workspace (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and their Google equivalents).
  • Comfortable designing for various media—digital, print, and even big formats.
  • Eager to dabble with AI in your workflow, and you’re open to new tech that enhances your creativity.
  • Know your way around social media graphics formatting—you get the vibe.
  • A knack for creating cohesive designs from brand identity guidelines (without breaking a sweat).
  • You can whip up mockups for design presentations like a true pro.


Bonus Points


  • You worship Canva or other online tools like it’s your creative playground.
  • You’re into AI design tools—we think they’re pretty rad, and you should too!



Our operating hours are Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST.


Ready for the ride of your life? If you think you’re the perfect fit for the role, submit your resume & portfolio today!

Atuará de forma próxima a times técnicos e gestores com alto nível de exigência, sendo fundamental postura profissional, domínio conceitual e clareza na comunicação.

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Customer Success Specialist. You will own the long-term success, retention, and expansion of active customers. This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Conduct regular account performance and campaign reviews
  • Analyze metrics (deliverability, response rates, conversion signals, etc)
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Advise customers on campaign optimization, list strategy, volume, and cadence
  • Act as a trusted partner focused on ROI and lead outcomes
  • Identify expansion opportunities aligned with customer growth (users, volume, add-ons)
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or churn risk - escalate and resolve
  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: Senior DataOps Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

The client operates in the health and information services domain, with a strong focus on enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale. Their mission centers on building a modern, cloud-based data platform that serves as a single source of truth for business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. The culture emphasizes data quality, governance, scalability, and collaboration across engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.


About the role

This role is focused on building and operating a robust data platform on Azure using Databricks. The engineer will play a key part in DataOps, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and reliability across enterprise-scale pipelines. You will design monitoring frameworks, implement data quality checks, and support governance initiatives. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders. It also requires strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a robust monitoring stack for jobs executed in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric, and other platform tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data catalogs in Unity Catalog and Purview
  • Design and implement a scalable framework for data quality checks across hundreds of columns on large datasets
  • Monitor data completeness and accuracy to ensure published data meets acceptable criteria
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions
  • Troubleshoot and optimize big data workflows for performance and scalability
  • Support governance and oversight of data pipelines and transformation activities
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in big data and analytics


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering / DataOps
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a Databricks environment (any cloud)
  • Strong experience with DataOps practices
  • Strong experience with data catalogs
  • Strong experience implementing data quality checks at scale
  • Strong Python experience
  • Strong proficiency in Data Governance processes and tools
  • Experience with Purview and/or Unity Catalog
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing
  • Experience with ETL processes, data cleaning, and large-scale data transformation
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an analytics-driven mindset
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience


Nice to have skills

  • Experience with Azure cloud services (preferred)
  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with GCP
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with DevOps practices


Conditions

  • 100% Remote role , primarily aligned to UTC-5 (EST) with a minimum of 5 hours overlap required
  • Contractor role – 6-month contract, renewable based on budget and performance
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week)
  • BYOD requirement



At Andela, we know our strengths lie in our diverse community whose talents, perspectives, backgrounds and orientations we take pride in. Andela is committed to nurturing a work environment where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Everyone has the right to work in a professional atmosphere that promotes equal employment opportunities and prohibits discriminatory practices.

Andela provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to factors including but not limited to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy (including breastfeeding), genetic information, HIV/AIDS or any other medical status, family or parental status, marital status, amnesty or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. This commitment applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation

title: UI/UX Graphic Designer | Remote | Brazil | Full-Time
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right. We’re seeking experienced, creative graphic designers to join our growing team.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.



What We’re Looking For


We’re looking for team players who live and breathe design. People who are creative powerhouses and thrive on pushing boundaries and finding ways to bring fresh ideas to life. Ready to join our team and start designing?


About You


  • You’re super motivated and genuinely passionate about nailing the job every time.
  • You’re a problem-solver, always a few steps ahead and never caught off guard.
  • You bring good vibes to the table—you’re respectful, friendly, and a great collaborator.
  • You’re a time management wizard.
  • You’re a team player
  • Communication is your jam—clear, concise, and always spot-on.
  • You’re resourceful—if you don’t know something, you don’t flinch. You’ve got Google, you’ve got grit, and you always figure it out.
  • Bonus points if you geek out on things like DND, Pokémon, or video games. Our team’s got some serious nerd cred, and we’re looking for like-minded peeps to join!


Qualifications and Skills


  • 2+ years of hands-on design experience—show us your growth and expertise
  • Proficiency in Figma and Webflow. You know the ins and outs of these tools like your favourite video game’s cheat codes
  • Mastery of the Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign—you live and breathe these tools.
  • A killer design portfolio that shows off your best work.
  • Working level of English (enough to communicate your ideas clearly, both in writing and speaking).
  • A bachelor’s degree is a plus.
  • Comfortable with Microsoft Office & Google Workspace (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and their Google equivalents).
  • Comfortable designing for various media—digital, print, and even big formats.
  • Eager to dabble with AI in your workflow, and you’re open to new tech that enhances your creativity.
  • Know your way around social media graphics formatting—you get the vibe.
  • A knack for creating cohesive designs from brand identity guidelines (without breaking a sweat).
  • You can whip up mockups for design presentations like a true pro.


Bonus Points


  • You worship Canva or other online tools like it’s your creative playground.
  • You’re into AI design tools—we think they’re pretty rad, and you should too!



Our operating hours are Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST.


Ready for the ride of your life? If you think you’re the perfect fit for the role, submit your resume & portfolio today!

description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Customer Success Specialist. You will own the long-term success, retention, and expansion of active customers. This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Conduct regular account performance and campaign reviews
  • Analyze metrics (deliverability, response rates, conversion signals, etc)
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Advise customers on campaign optimization, list strategy, volume, and cadence
  • Act as a trusted partner focused on ROI and lead outcomes
  • Identify expansion opportunities aligned with customer growth (users, volume, add-ons)
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or churn risk - escalate and resolve
  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Customer Success Specialist. You will own the long-term success, retention, and expansion of active customers. This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Conduct regular account performance and campaign reviews
  • Analyze metrics (deliverability, response rates, conversion signals, etc)
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Advise customers on campaign optimization, list strategy, volume, and cadence
  • Act as a trusted partner focused on ROI and lead outcomes
  • Identify expansion opportunities aligned with customer growth (users, volume, add-ons)
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or churn risk - escalate and resolve
  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: Senior DataOps Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

The client operates in the health and information services domain, with a strong focus on enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale. Their mission centers on building a modern, cloud-based data platform that serves as a single source of truth for business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. The culture emphasizes data quality, governance, scalability, and collaboration across engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.


About the role

This role is focused on building and operating a robust data platform on Azure using Databricks. The engineer will play a key part in DataOps, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and reliability across enterprise-scale pipelines. You will design monitoring frameworks, implement data quality checks, and support governance initiatives. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders. It also requires strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a robust monitoring stack for jobs executed in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric, and other platform tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data catalogs in Unity Catalog and Purview
  • Design and implement a scalable framework for data quality checks across hundreds of columns on large datasets
  • Monitor data completeness and accuracy to ensure published data meets acceptable criteria
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions
  • Troubleshoot and optimize big data workflows for performance and scalability
  • Support governance and oversight of data pipelines and transformation activities
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in big data and analytics


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering / DataOps
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a Databricks environment (any cloud)
  • Strong experience with DataOps practices
  • Strong experience with data catalogs
  • Strong experience implementing data quality checks at scale
  • Strong Python experience
  • Strong proficiency in Data Governance processes and tools
  • Experience with Purview and/or Unity Catalog
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing
  • Experience with ETL processes, data cleaning, and large-scale data transformation
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an analytics-driven mindset
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience


Nice to have skills

  • Experience with Azure cloud services (preferred)
  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with GCP
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with DevOps practices


Conditions

  • 100% Remote role , primarily aligned to UTC-5 (EST) with a minimum of 5 hours overlap required
  • Contractor role – 6-month contract, renewable based on budget and performance
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week)
  • BYOD requirement

title: Executivo Comercial
description:
Descrição da Empresa:


A Compliance for Business é uma consultoria referência em Governança Corporativa, atuando em áreas como Compliance, LGPD, DPO Externo, Canal de Denúncias, Investigações Corporativas e Treinamentos. Ajudamos empresas a estarem em conformidade com as mais rigorosas leis e regulamentos, garantindo a segurança jurídica e de dados dos nossos clientes. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais apaixonados por transformar o mundo corporativo e educar nossos clientes sobre melhores práticas de governança, compliance e privacidade.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Prospectar ativamente e Qualificar leads em diversos canais;
  • Conduzir o processo de vendas consultivas;
  • Realizar reuniões virtuais para apresentar nossas soluções;
  • Negociar com empresas para gerar uma nova venda;
  • Manter relacionamento com clientes estratégicos da carteira, aconselhando as reuniões realizadas para gerar oportunidades de negócios futuros;
  • Fornecer, acompanhar e entregar as documentações possíveis para fechamento da venda (contratos e outros documentos);
  • Acompanhar a ativação desses novos clientes convertidos, garantindo a efetividade da venda feita;
  • Participar de reuniões internas para colaborar com estratégias e alavancar resultados


O que buscamos no seu perfil

  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Proatividade e organização
  • Experiência em vendas de Serviços B2B;
  • Experiência em vendas SaaS B2B
  • Experiência em Prospecção Ativa em diversos canais 
  • Atuação prévia com vendas Outbound


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em metodologia de vendas;
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma e com gestão do tempo;
  • Ensino médio completo (superior será um diferencial);
  • Conhecimento básico em ferramentas digitais (planilhas, e-mail, CRM etc.);
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho remoto de segunda à sexta-feira.


O que oferecemos

  • Regime 100% home-office
  • Comissionamento
  • Oportunidade de crescimento dentro de uma empresa em forte expansão.
  • Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo com grande potencial de aprendizado.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Hourly Role | Remote | PST Hours


Chosan is hiring a Virtual Operations Specialist (VOS) to support our fast growing luxury housing and lifestyle platform. This role sits at the center of day to day operations and leasing and is ideal for someone who is organized, responsive, and comfortable handling multiple workflows at once.


Role Overview


The VOS supports both operations and leasing functions across our portfolio. You will be responsible for guest and prospect communication, lease and payment processing, and operational coordination to ensure a smooth experience for residents and internal teams.


This is an hourly paid position with core weekday hours and required weekend availability.


Schedule


Core hours: 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM PST, Monday through Friday

Weekend availability required on a rotating or as needed basis


Key Responsibilities


Respond to guest and prospect inquiries across multiple platforms

Handle and coordinate maintenance requests with vendors and internal teams

Send invoices and follow up on payments

Reconcile payments and flag discrepancies

Process leases, extensions, and related documentation

Respond to leasing and availability inquiries

Support day to day operational workflows and internal coordination

Maintain clear and professional written communication at all times


Requirements


Strong written English and professional communication skills

Highly organized with strong attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast paced environment

Comfortable working with operational tools, CRMs, and property management systems

Reliable internet connection and ability to work PST hours

Availability to work weekends as required


What This Role Is Not


This is not a passive admin role. You will be actively managing live guest issues, payments, and leasing workflows. Responsiveness, accountability, and ownership are critical.


Why Chosan


Chosan is a luxury lifestyle and housing company redefining flexible living. We move fast, operate with high standards, and expect our team to do the same. If you enjoy operations, problem solving, and being at the center of the action, this role is a strong fit.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Customer Success Specialist. You will own the long-term success, retention, and expansion of active customers. This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Conduct regular account performance and campaign reviews
  • Analyze metrics (deliverability, response rates, conversion signals, etc)
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Advise customers on campaign optimization, list strategy, volume, and cadence
  • Act as a trusted partner focused on ROI and lead outcomes
  • Identify expansion opportunities aligned with customer growth (users, volume, add-ons)
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or churn risk - escalate and resolve
  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: Senior DataOps Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

The client operates in the health and information services domain, with a strong focus on enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale. Their mission centers on building a modern, cloud-based data platform that serves as a single source of truth for business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. The culture emphasizes data quality, governance, scalability, and collaboration across engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.


About the role

This role is focused on building and operating a robust data platform on Azure using Databricks. The engineer will play a key part in DataOps, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and reliability across enterprise-scale pipelines. You will design monitoring frameworks, implement data quality checks, and support governance initiatives. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders. It also requires strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a robust monitoring stack for jobs executed in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric, and other platform tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data catalogs in Unity Catalog and Purview
  • Design and implement a scalable framework for data quality checks across hundreds of columns on large datasets
  • Monitor data completeness and accuracy to ensure published data meets acceptable criteria
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions
  • Troubleshoot and optimize big data workflows for performance and scalability
  • Support governance and oversight of data pipelines and transformation activities
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in big data and analytics


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering / DataOps
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a Databricks environment (any cloud)
  • Strong experience with DataOps practices
  • Strong experience with data catalogs
  • Strong experience implementing data quality checks at scale
  • Strong Python experience
  • Strong proficiency in Data Governance processes and tools
  • Experience with Purview and/or Unity Catalog
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing
  • Experience with ETL processes, data cleaning, and large-scale data transformation
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an analytics-driven mindset
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience


Nice to have skills

  • Experience with Azure cloud services (preferred)
  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with GCP
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with DevOps practices


Conditions

  • 100% Remote role , primarily aligned to UTC-5 (EST) with a minimum of 5 hours overlap required
  • Contractor role – 6-month contract, renewable based on budget and performance
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week)
  • BYOD requirement

title: Executivo Comercial
description:
Descrição da Empresa:


A Compliance for Business é uma consultoria referência em Governança Corporativa, atuando em áreas como Compliance, LGPD, DPO Externo, Canal de Denúncias, Investigações Corporativas e Treinamentos. Ajudamos empresas a estarem em conformidade com as mais rigorosas leis e regulamentos, garantindo a segurança jurídica e de dados dos nossos clientes. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais apaixonados por transformar o mundo corporativo e educar nossos clientes sobre melhores práticas de governança, compliance e privacidade.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Prospectar ativamente e Qualificar leads em diversos canais;
  • Conduzir o processo de vendas consultivas;
  • Realizar reuniões virtuais para apresentar nossas soluções;
  • Negociar com empresas para gerar uma nova venda;
  • Manter relacionamento com clientes estratégicos da carteira, aconselhando as reuniões realizadas para gerar oportunidades de negócios futuros;
  • Fornecer, acompanhar e entregar as documentações possíveis para fechamento da venda (contratos e outros documentos);
  • Acompanhar a ativação desses novos clientes convertidos, garantindo a efetividade da venda feita;
  • Participar de reuniões internas para colaborar com estratégias e alavancar resultados


O que buscamos no seu perfil

  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Proatividade e organização
  • Experiência em vendas de Serviços B2B;
  • Experiência em vendas SaaS B2B
  • Experiência em Prospecção Ativa em diversos canais 
  • Atuação prévia com vendas Outbound


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em metodologia de vendas;
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma e com gestão do tempo;
  • Ensino médio completo (superior será um diferencial);
  • Conhecimento básico em ferramentas digitais (planilhas, e-mail, CRM etc.);
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho remoto de segunda à sexta-feira.


O que oferecemos

  • Regime 100% home-office
  • Comissionamento
  • Oportunidade de crescimento dentro de uma empresa em forte expansão.
  • Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo com grande potencial de aprendizado.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Hourly Role | Remote | PST Hours


Chosan is hiring a Virtual Operations Specialist (VOS) to support our fast growing luxury housing and lifestyle platform. This role sits at the center of day to day operations and leasing and is ideal for someone who is organized, responsive, and comfortable handling multiple workflows at once.


Role Overview


The VOS supports both operations and leasing functions across our portfolio. You will be responsible for guest and prospect communication, lease and payment processing, and operational coordination to ensure a smooth experience for residents and internal teams.


This is an hourly paid position with core weekday hours and required weekend availability.


Schedule


Core hours: 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM PST, Monday through Friday

Weekend availability required on a rotating or as needed basis


Key Responsibilities


Respond to guest and prospect inquiries across multiple platforms

Handle and coordinate maintenance requests with vendors and internal teams

Send invoices and follow up on payments

Reconcile payments and flag discrepancies

Process leases, extensions, and related documentation

Respond to leasing and availability inquiries

Support day to day operational workflows and internal coordination

Maintain clear and professional written communication at all times


Requirements


Strong written English and professional communication skills

Highly organized with strong attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast paced environment

Comfortable working with operational tools, CRMs, and property management systems

Reliable internet connection and ability to work PST hours

Availability to work weekends as required


What This Role Is Not


This is not a passive admin role. You will be actively managing live guest issues, payments, and leasing workflows. Responsiveness, accountability, and ownership are critical.


Why Chosan


Chosan is a luxury lifestyle and housing company redefining flexible living. We move fast, operate with high standards, and expect our team to do the same. If you enjoy operations, problem solving, and being at the center of the action, this role is a strong fit.

title: Analista de Dados Jr.
description:
O Analista de BI Júnior, com foco em analise e visualização de dados, responsável pela criação de índices estatísticos, pela gestão e limpeza de bases de dados e pela prestação de apoio de retaguarda, tanto a nível do desenvolvimento como da manutenção. Além disso, ele/ela implementa sistemas de automação e alertas que melhoram a eficiência, reduzem os tempos de auditoria e garantem a integridade e disponibilidade dos dados. Ele/ela também tem conhecimento de plataformas como Excel, Looker e Power Bi para relatórios e relatórios.


Principais Atribuições:


  • Capacidade de gerar insights e apoiar a tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Proficiência em Power BI, Looker e Excel (é necessário pelo menos um avançado);
  • Visualização de dados: Capacidade de criar visualizações claras e eficazes, facilitando a interpretação dos dados por equipas não técnicas;
  • Conhecimento em Google Analytics;
  • Comunicação eficaz: Capacidade de apresentar análises e resultados a diferentes públicos, tanto técnicos como não técnicos;
  • Colaboração interdisciplinar: Experiência de trabalho com equipas multifuncionais para alinhar a análise de dados com as necessidades estratégicas;
  • Capacidade para avaliar e contextualizar dados: Capacidade para interpretar a informação no contexto;
  • Capacidade para identificar padrões e tendências: Capacidade para detectar alterações ou movimentos significativos nos dados que possam influenciar a estratégia;
  • Abordagem analítica com sentido prático: capacidade de propor soluções eficazes baseadas em dados, tendo em conta as implicações e as necessidades.


Requisitos


  • Python e SQL para desenvolvimentos e processamento de dados;
  • Experiência com Google Analytics e Big Query;
  • Conhecimentos de estatística e matemática (desejável):
  • Conhecimento de estatística.

title: Desenvolvedor de Software C++
description:
A AEL está em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de Software C++ para atuar em cooperação com times globais em projetos de Comando, Controle, Comunicações, Computadores e Inteligência (C4I). Se você tem paixão por tecnologia, experiência em sistemas embarcados em tempo real e deseja trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e inovadores voltados para comunicações táticas, essa oportunidade é para você!


Nessa posição você terá o desafio de

  • Participar integralmente do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software para Rádios Definidos por Software (SDR), incluindo especificação, codificação, testes e manutenção;
  • Desenvolver e integrar software embarcado em sistemas de comunicação de alta complexidade, com foco em desempenho, confiabilidade e escalabilidade;
  • Interagir com equipes multidisciplinares, de hardware, sistemas e engenharia, garantindo alinhamento técnico e integração eficiente entre componentes;
  • Executar testes unitários, funcionais e de integração, além de realizar validações e depuração de software em ambiente de desenvolvimento e produção.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Sólida experiência em programação C++ (5 anos ou mais), com foco em orientação a objetos;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em redes e protocolos de comunicação;
  • Domínio de metodologias de debug;
  • Conhecimento em integração software/hardware;
  • Experiência com sistemas operacionais de tempo real e Linux embarcado;
  • Proatividade e capacidade de resolução de problemas;
  • Inglês fluente;
  • Graduação em Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de rádio e/ou redes será um diferencial;
  • Experiência prévia em projetos com VXWorks será um diferencial.


O que a AEL te proporciona

  • Política de horários flexível e modelo híbrido: Atuamos com banco de horas e um dia de atuação remota, proporcionando uma rotina flexível
  • Plano de Saúde Unimed: Custos de adesão subsidiados pela AEL
  • Seguro de Vida: Zelamos pela sua proteção e de seus familiares
  • Vale Alimentação e Refeitório: Utilizamos o cartão multibenefícios Flash e contamos com refeitório na empresa
  • Auxílio Mobilidade/Vale Transporte: Facilitamos o seu deslocamento diário com opções que se adaptam à sua rotina
  • Estimulamos o equilíbrio da vida pessoal e profissional: Temos um calendário anual de feriados e férias coletivas, visando estimular o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional
  • Celebramos nossas conquistas: temos diversas ações de confraternização e reconhecimento, celebrando os atingimentos da jornada
  • Auxílio idioma: Investimos no seu desenvolvimento através do aprimoramento em inglês
  • Prêmio de fim de ano: Reconhecemos os desafios atingidos ao fim do ano
  • Incentivos à prática de atividades físicas: Investimos na sua saúde através de grupos de corrida, ginástica funcional e ginástica laboral
  • Bebê AEL: Celebramos a chegada de novos membros das famílias
  • Empresa Cidadã: Contamos com dias estendidos de licença maternidade e paternidade

Excelência faz parte da nossa cultura. Está em tudo o que fazemos, nos processos, na forma de ser e inovar. title: Crypto Venture Analyst
description:
Crypto Venture Analyst

Company: Meta Martian

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Department: Investment & Research

Compensation Strategy

Salary Range: $70,000 – $100,000 USD / year We pay in USD or USDC. This compensation package is explicitly benchmarked to the top 1% of the Brazilian venture capital market. We believe in rewarding high-conviction insights, not just hours worked.

The Investment Mandate and Regional Focus

Meta Martian is deploying capital into the builders who are re-architecting the internet. We are seeking a Crypto Venture Analyst based in Brazil to act as our eyes and ears in the LATAM market-one of the fastest-growing crypto adoption zones in the world. Your mandate is to identify high-signal opportunities before they hit the mainstream radar. You are not here to follow the herd; you are here to build the thesis that the herd will eventually follow. You will be dissecting early-stage protocols, connecting with founders in São Paulo, Rio, and Buenos Aires, and feeding high-quality deal flow into our global investment committee.

Due Diligence and Deal Flow Mechanics

This role is the engine of our decision-making process. You will lead the rigorous \"under the hood\" inspection of potential investments. This goes far beyond reading a pitch deck. We expect you to scrutinize the technical architecture, challenge the founders on their go-to-market assumptions, and verify the integrity of their team. You will manage the entire deal funnel: from the first coffee meeting with a founder to writing the final Investment Memo that convinces our partners to sign a check. You must be comfortable asking uncomfortable questions to protect our capital.

Thesis Generation and Tokenomics Forensics

We do not invest in \"vibes.\" We invest in sustainable mechanics. A core part of your role is Tokenomic Stress-Testing . You will take a project's proposed token distribution and model it out over 5 years. You must answer critical questions: Does the token capture value? Is the inflation schedule predatory? Is the FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation) realistic compared to competitors? You will produce deep-dive sector research-whether on DePIN, Zero-Knowledge proofs, or RWA-that shapes our firm's view on where the market is heading over the next cycle.

What We Are Not Looking For (The Anti-Persona)

To respect your time, let us define what this role is not :

  • Not a \"Spray and Pray\" Investor: We are a high-conviction fund. If you like throwing small checks at every meme coin, this is not for you.
  • Not a Passive Observer: If you wait for deals to come to your inbox, you will fail. We need a hunter who is active in the developer trenches.
  • Not a Chart Watcher: This is a Venture Capital role (Seed/Series A), not a liquid hedge fund role. We do not care about daily price action; we care about multi-year technology horizons.
The Analyst Archetype
  • You are deeply embedded in the crypto culture. You likely have a \"degen\" past but a professional present. You are fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus). You have a network of developers and builders in Brazil who trust you. You are intellectually honest-you are willing to kill your own favorite deal if the data shows it is a bad investment. You combine the networking skills of a BD manager with the analytical rigor of a mathematician.

We do not invest in \"vibes.\" We invest in sustainable mechanics. A core part of your role is Tokenomic Stress-Testing . You will take a project's proposed token distribution and model it out over 5 years. You must answer critical questions: Does the token capture value? Is the inflation schedule predatory? Is the FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation) realistic compared to competitors? You will produce deep-dive sector research-whether on DePIN, Zero-Knowledge proofs, or RWA-that shapes our firm's view on where the market is heading over the next cycle.

What We Are Not Looking For (The Anti-Persona)

To respect your time, let us define what this role is not :

  • Not a \"Spray and Pray\" Investor: We are a high-conviction fund. If you like throwing small checks at every meme coin, this is not for you.
  • Not a Passive Observer: If you wait for deals to come to your inbox, you will fail. We need a hunter who is active in the developer trenches.
  • Not a Chart Watcher: This is a Venture Capital role (Seed/Series A), not a liquid hedge fund role. We do not care about daily price action; we care about multi-year technology horizons.
The Analyst Archetype
  • You are deeply embedded in the crypto culture. You likely have a \"degen\" past but a professional present. You are fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus). You have a network of developers and builders in Brazil who trust you. You are intellectually honest-you are willing to kill your own favorite deal if the data shows it is a bad investment. You combine the networking skills of a BD manager with the analytical rigor of a mathematician.

title: Senior DataOps Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

The client operates in the health and information services domain, with a strong focus on enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale. Their mission centers on building a modern, cloud-based data platform that serves as a single source of truth for business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. The culture emphasizes data quality, governance, scalability, and collaboration across engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.


About the role

This role is focused on building and operating a robust data platform on Azure using Databricks. The engineer will play a key part in DataOps, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and reliability across enterprise-scale pipelines. You will design monitoring frameworks, implement data quality checks, and support governance initiatives. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders. It also requires strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a robust monitoring stack for jobs executed in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric, and other platform tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data catalogs in Unity Catalog and Purview
  • Design and implement a scalable framework for data quality checks across hundreds of columns on large datasets
  • Monitor data completeness and accuracy to ensure published data meets acceptable criteria
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions
  • Troubleshoot and optimize big data workflows for performance and scalability
  • Support governance and oversight of data pipelines and transformation activities
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in big data and analytics


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering / DataOps
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a Databricks environment (any cloud)
  • Strong experience with DataOps practices
  • Strong experience with data catalogs
  • Strong experience implementing data quality checks at scale
  • Strong Python experience
  • Strong proficiency in Data Governance processes and tools
  • Experience with Purview and/or Unity Catalog
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing
  • Experience with ETL processes, data cleaning, and large-scale data transformation
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an analytics-driven mindset
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience


Nice to have skills

  • Experience with Azure cloud services (preferred)
  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with GCP
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with DevOps practices


Conditions

  • 100% Remote role , primarily aligned to UTC-5 (EST) with a minimum of 5 hours overlap required
  • Contractor role – 6-month contract, renewable based on budget and performance
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week)
  • BYOD requirement

title: Executivo Comercial
description:
Descrição da Empresa:


A Compliance for Business é uma consultoria referência em Governança Corporativa, atuando em áreas como Compliance, LGPD, DPO Externo, Canal de Denúncias, Investigações Corporativas e Treinamentos. Ajudamos empresas a estarem em conformidade com as mais rigorosas leis e regulamentos, garantindo a segurança jurídica e de dados dos nossos clientes. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais apaixonados por transformar o mundo corporativo e educar nossos clientes sobre melhores práticas de governança, compliance e privacidade.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Prospectar ativamente e Qualificar leads em diversos canais;
  • Conduzir o processo de vendas consultivas;
  • Realizar reuniões virtuais para apresentar nossas soluções;
  • Negociar com empresas para gerar uma nova venda;
  • Manter relacionamento com clientes estratégicos da carteira, aconselhando as reuniões realizadas para gerar oportunidades de negócios futuros;
  • Fornecer, acompanhar e entregar as documentações possíveis para fechamento da venda (contratos e outros documentos);
  • Acompanhar a ativação desses novos clientes convertidos, garantindo a efetividade da venda feita;
  • Participar de reuniões internas para colaborar com estratégias e alavancar resultados


O que buscamos no seu perfil

  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Proatividade e organização
  • Experiência em vendas de Serviços B2B;
  • Experiência em vendas SaaS B2B
  • Experiência em Prospecção Ativa em diversos canais 
  • Atuação prévia com vendas Outbound


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em metodologia de vendas;
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma e com gestão do tempo;
  • Ensino médio completo (superior será um diferencial);
  • Conhecimento básico em ferramentas digitais (planilhas, e-mail, CRM etc.);
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho remoto de segunda à sexta-feira.


O que oferecemos

  • Regime 100% home-office
  • Comissionamento
  • Oportunidade de crescimento dentro de uma empresa em forte expansão.
  • Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo com grande potencial de aprendizado.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Hourly Role | Remote | PST Hours


Chosan is hiring a Virtual Operations Specialist (VOS) to support our fast growing luxury housing and lifestyle platform. This role sits at the center of day to day operations and leasing and is ideal for someone who is organized, responsive, and comfortable handling multiple workflows at once.


Role Overview


The VOS supports both operations and leasing functions across our portfolio. You will be responsible for guest and prospect communication, lease and payment processing, and operational coordination to ensure a smooth experience for residents and internal teams.


This is an hourly paid position with core weekday hours and required weekend availability.


Schedule


Core hours: 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM PST, Monday through Friday

Weekend availability required on a rotating or as needed basis


Key Responsibilities


Respond to guest and prospect inquiries across multiple platforms

Handle and coordinate maintenance requests with vendors and internal teams

Send invoices and follow up on payments

Reconcile payments and flag discrepancies

Process leases, extensions, and related documentation

Respond to leasing and availability inquiries

Support day to day operational workflows and internal coordination

Maintain clear and professional written communication at all times


Requirements


Strong written English and professional communication skills

Highly organized with strong attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast paced environment

Comfortable working with operational tools, CRMs, and property management systems

Reliable internet connection and ability to work PST hours

Availability to work weekends as required


What This Role Is Not


This is not a passive admin role. You will be actively managing live guest issues, payments, and leasing workflows. Responsiveness, accountability, and ownership are critical.


Why Chosan


Chosan is a luxury lifestyle and housing company redefining flexible living. We move fast, operate with high standards, and expect our team to do the same. If you enjoy operations, problem solving, and being at the center of the action, this role is a strong fit.
